details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/validation-refresh.yml:93-94 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: `VALIDATION_DISCOVERY_ENABLED` is derived only from `github.event.inputs.discovery_enabled || 'true'`, so scheduled runs never consult `vars.VALIDATION_DISCOVERY_ENABLED`.
  WHY: On cron-triggered runs `github.event.inputs` is null, so discovery stays enabled even when the repo variable is set to false.
- scripts/validation_discovery_bootstrap.py:325-335 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The `FileNotFoundError` branch under `discover_manifest_via_codex()` has inconsistent indentation around the comment/return block; reviewers disagreed on whether it is only a lint issue or an import-time `IndentationError`, but the indentation is definitely malformed.
  WHY: The `return` is indented under the `elif` at a different level than the surrounding comments/branching, so the module can fail to import or at minimum fail lint CI; highest reported severity was critical.
- scripts/validation_discovery_bootstrap.py:468-515 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `_find_existing_open_pr_url` filters open PRs by head only and omits `--base`, so it can reuse a PR targeting the wrong base branch.
  WHY: If the same head branch has open PRs against different bases, the function can return the wrong URL and skip creating the intended discovery PR.
- scripts/validation_discovery_bootstrap.py:319-340 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The catch-all exception path in `discover_manifest_via_codex()` does not consistently handle `CommandFailure` from `validation_refresh_runner.CommandExecutor.run(..., check=True)`.
  WHY: A wrapped non-zero exit can bubble out instead of becoming a typed `DiscoveryResult(failure_reason=...)`, aborting dispatch and leaving the consumer clone in a mutated state.
- scripts/validation_refresh_runner.py:249-263 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The post-discovery tree-reset guard only runs for `("pr_opened", "pr_reused", "failed", "push_denied")`, so outcomes like `agree`, `skipped_dedup`, `dry_run`, and `disabled` skip the reset.
  WHY: Discovery can leave the working tree mutated, and the later drift pipeline then renders against the wrong state.
- scripts/validation_refresh_runner.py:826-834 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `_dedup_skip` builds a `bash -c` command string by interpolating `repository` directly.
  WHY: Current validation makes this non-exploitable now, but the pattern is brittle and would become shell-injection-prone if input validation ever weakens.
- scripts/validation_refresh_runner.py:909-938 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `_append_discovery_memory` builds a `bash -c` command string by interpolating `repository` and `entry_file` directly.
  WHY: The same brittle shell interpolation can break on special characters or become injection-prone if the current guards change.
- scripts/validation_discovery_bootstrap.py:728-755 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: `_is_missing_pr_label_error` can misclassify errors because the regex is evaluated after a broad label-substring check and can still trigger on unrelated messages mentioning the label and `not found`.
  WHY: That can cause the label-less fallback path to open a PR without the intended label.
- ai-memory/schemas/validation_discovery.v1.json:49-77 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `dry_run` handling is not fully synchronized between the schema and the Python normalization/enum path.
  WHY: Reviewers disagreed on whether the remaining mismatch is the tuple vs schema or just the error message/comment, but they agreed the contract is out of sync and can reject or misreport `dry_run` entries.
- agents.md:205-219 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: New `VALIDATION_DISCOVERY_*` log prefixes were added without an alongside-old shim.
  WHY: That can break downstream scrapers or reports that rely on the prior stable-prefix set.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
